##### Project general facts

Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti is a landmark residential hyper-tower that redefines contemporary architecture through a fusion of innovation, elegance, and iconic design. Inspired by the Mercedes-Benz philosophy of Sensual Purity, the tower features bold proportions, fluid lines, and a distinctive façade incorporating elements of the three-pointed star, creating a powerful and recognizable presence within the skyline. The project embodies a seamless balance between beauty and functionality, offering a new vision of modern urban living shaped by precision and sophistication.

Residents benefit from a thoughtfully designed environment that combines lifestyle, comfort, and exclusivity. The development is conceived to deliver a refined living experience, with spaces that encourage relaxation, social interaction, and everyday convenience. Its architectural concept integrates multiple design languages, resulting in a dynamic setting where innovation meets elegance, and where residents can enjoy a lifestyle defined by quality and distinction.

Interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and a harmonious palette of refined tones, creating a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. Every detail reflects a sense of balance and craftsmanship, enhancing both comfort and aesthetic appeal. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, ensuring functionality for daily living. Units are available both furnished and unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their interiors while benefiting from high-quality finishes and a strong design foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. 

The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. 

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
